title: Collateral Desk Guidance: Appraisal Age at the Scheduled Closing and the Appraisal Update Line on a Mortgage Loan File
content:
When a Mortgage Loan File's corrected Closing Disclosure is figured, the appraisal update line is decided by how old the file's appraisal will be on the scheduled closing date. The appraisal read is the file's primary Appraisal Order in delivered status — an order placed on the file as a standard order, a transferred-in order or a new order after expiration. The age is measured in calendar days from that order's inspection date to the scheduled closing date, and it is compared with two figures set for the order's report type in the Appraisal Order report-type schedule: the validity period (the maximum age of the report without an update) and the maximum age reachable with an update.

**Rule.** A report older than its report type's validity period and also older than its maximum age with an update (a report type that allows no update carries a maximum age with an update below its validity period) needs a new appraisal and adds that report type's appraisal fee (the base fee for the report); a report older than its report type's validity period but no older than its maximum age with an update needs an update of the appraisal and adds that report type's reinspection fee; a report no older than its validity period, or a file with no primary appraisal order in delivered status or no scheduled closing date, adds nothing for the appraisal.

| Age of the appraisal on the scheduled closing date | Appraisal update line |
|---|---|
| older than the validity period and also older than the maximum age with an update | the report type's appraisal fee (new appraisal) |
| older than the validity period, but no older than the maximum age with an update | the report type's reinspection fee (update) |
| no older than the validity period | nothing |
| no primary appraisal order in delivered status on the file | nothing |
| no scheduled closing date on the file | nothing |

"Older than" means more days than the figure; an age equal to the figure is "no older than" it.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical report type with a 120-day validity period and a 365-day maximum age with an update)

| Inspection date to scheduled closing date | Line |
|---|---|
| 120 days | nothing — no older than the validity period |
| 121 days | the reinspection fee |
| 365 days | the reinspection fee — no older than the maximum age with an update |
| 366 days | the appraisal fee for a new report |

## A report type that allows no update (hypothetical 120-day validity period, maximum age with an update of 0 days)

| Inspection date to scheduled closing date | Line |
|---|---|
| 120 days | nothing |
| 121 days | the appraisal fee for a new report — older than both figures |

The figures for each report type, and the fees, are those of the Appraisal Order on the file; the figures above are illustrations only.
